label: Trade War Room: two-team offers can now be staged instead of sent straight to MFL -- held server-side for the other owner to review and accept, so a roster change between offer and acceptance can never sneak a trade through. Before sending or staging a two-team or three-team offer, a popup now shows the projected loaded-contract count for BOTH affected teams (not just your own), with each affected owner picking only their own conditional drops. A new Staged Trades list and detail view (Accept, Decline, Cancel, Re-check) works the same on mobile and desktop.
